finding: Police (code 62) includes the whole Statement of Activities line 'Public safety: Other' ($54.3M: city jail, building division inspections, excise, emergency management, civilian oversight, public safety administration). Census abstracted this city's record from the accrual government-wide Statement of Activities: police $170.281M + other $54.349M = E62 $224.630M exactly, and fire, judicial, streets, health, interest, airport and water each equal their Statement of Activities line to the dollar. Operational police is about $170M, not $225M.

Corrections may be counted twice: the jail sits inside 'Public safety: Other' (already in E62) and Census also records E04 corrections $24.85M, E05 $17.19M and E66 inspection $7.86M. Census current operations plus interest exceed the Statement of Activities total by $97.7M, of which these three codes are $49.9M and transit (E94) $41.2M; spending can reach the Census record from outside that statement, so this is not proof.
evidence: Census 2022 unit file; FY2022 ACFR PDF p.37
